claims.content: To successfully purchase won auction items by selecting a payment method and completing the transaction.

goal.raw_text: To successfully purchase won auction items by selecting a payment method and completing the transaction.

claims.content: Customer
The customer must have a registered account with JTVauctions.com.
The customer must be logged into their account.
The customer must have at least one item in their shopping cart or have won an auction requiring payment.
A valid shipping address must be defined in the customer's profile or entered during the checkout process.
The customer clicks the 'Checkout' button after reviewing their shopping cart or won auction items.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Checkout' button after reviewing their shopping cart or won auction items.

claims.content: Customer selects items to purchase and proceeds to checkout.
System displays the 'Checkout' page showing order summary, shipping address options, and payment method selection.
Customer reviews order details and selects or confirms a shipping address.
Customer selects a payment method (Credit Card, PayPal, or Amazon Payments).
If Credit Card is selected, customer enters card details; if PayPal or Amazon Payments is selected, customer is redirected to the respective third-party site to log in and authorize payment.
Customer clicks 'Place Order' or equivalent button to submit payment.
System validates payment information and processes the transaction via the selected payment gateway.
Upon successful payment, system displays a confirmation page with order number and summary.
System sends an order confirmation email to the customer.
The customer's order is successfully recorded in the system with a unique order number.
Payment for the order has been successfully processed and authorized by the selected payment gateway (Credit Card, PayPal, or Amazon Payments).
An order confirmation email containing the order summary and details has been sent to the customer.
The purchased items are marked as 'sold' or removed from available inventory.
If the purchase was for auction items, the customer's status for those items is updated to reflect successful payment.
